title: Smooth Surfaces Intersecting 2-planes
exact_target: In all sufficiently large dimensions, must every smooth local surface of codimension two meet some affine two-plane in at least five points?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 134 (GREEN-046). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author collection, Problem 73 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
